# sh-fpv-lifestyle

**Purpose:** Lifestyle & Interests (diet, location, hobbies).

**Built from:** sh-fpv-section-title + sh-fpv-info-item + hobby sh-icons, or sh-fpv-tit-for-tat-card.

**Switches:** State.

**Rules:** tit for tat only for a Free viewer without his own details; tit for tat shows no title chip.

**Taps:** Add Now → add own details.
